subject: Aurora pilot — temporarily pausing demo while roadmap shifts
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@auroratech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora pilot — demo next week?

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Wanted to lock in a short technical + product demo so our Solutions team can map Redwood inference into Aurora's analytics roadmap. Proposed slot: Tuesday 21 Jun, 10:00–10:45 PT (we can tighten to 30 mins).

Agenda (30–45m):
- Quick goals check (5m)
- Architecture + integration patterns for inference at scale (10m)
- Live walkthrough: caching, batching, predictable latency (10m)
- Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan (5–20m)

I attached a one-pager and a starter mutual action plan for the pilot so you have something to share with engineering/procurement. If the time doesn’t work, tell me two windows and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — cc’ing Dev (SE) and Laura (CS) who would join the demo.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
- aurora-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Samir Patel <samir@auroratech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@auroratech.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora pilot — demo next week?

Mina — thanks for the invite and for the materials. Quick update from our side: we just kicked off a company-wide data platform migration and leadership has temporarily reallocated engineering resources away from new ML/LLM initiatives to focus on core infra.

As a result, we need to pause new pilots that require cross-team bandwidth (including inference work) for the next two quarters. Key constraints:
- Headcount reassignment (2x engs moved to infra migration)
- Procurement freeze for new vendor pilots until Q4 (budget reforecast in Sept)
- Product roadmap shifted to prioritize ingestion and observability work for H2

I don’t want to ghost — we still see value in Redwood for the future, but we can’t commit to a demo or pilot timeframe right now. Please keep us on file and send any lightweight materials we can share internally; we’ll re-evaluate in October.

Priya, feel free to add anything I missed.

Best,
Samir
VP Product, Aurora Technologies
samir@auroratech.com

Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora pilot — demo next week?

Samir — appreciate the context and the honest timing call. Totally understand the migration taking priority. Two quick things from our side that might make it easier when you’re ready again:

1) Lightweight internal checklist (one page) — what Aurora should have ready to pick up an inference pilot quickly (networking, API auth, sample dataset, success metrics). I’ll send this as a short Google Doc you can circulate.

2) Optional low-effort options — a short 2-hour architecture review (no infra changes required) or a deferred PoC window where we hold a small credit commitment and run a limited smoke test as soon as you are ready. No pressure — we’ll work to match your timing.

We’ll also log a reminder to check back in Oct. If it helps, I can add a couple of checklist items that map to your procurement freeze so the packet is ready for when budget opens.

Next steps: I’ll share the checklist + a stripped-down MAP link. Dev/Laura — flag if you want to add technical caveats or examples for the checklist.

Thanks,
Mina

Appreciate the flexibility — Samir
